rules.why: No plan is approved in this session: present one with run('plan', 'plan_present'), ask the user with the form, then edit.
The approved plan does not name this file: present a new revision that names it and ask the user again.
The state of the harness (its ledger, its maint grant) is written by the harness only, never by an edit.

The harness's data (state/) is never opened by the shell, Read, Grep or Glob: read the ledger with run('ledger', 'db_query', {sql}), one read-only SELECT; run('maint', 'status') says whether the guards are off.
Only the user answers a form: call AskUserQuestion with the questions alone.
A question of a form may not hold '"="': ask the questions as the harness gave them.
Harness không đọc trọn được lệnh này nên hỏi bạn trước khi chạy; Allow chỉ khi lời giải thích khớp với lệnh
The harness cannot read this command whole, so it asks the user before it runs: write in the tool's description, in plain words, what the command does and what it changes, then run it again.
The turn does not end yet: code files of the plan changed since the last green verify. Run python3 -m entry.cli verify (bare, from .claude/) and fix what is red.
